construct: FGFR3 normally restrains endochondral bone growth. The common achondroplasia p.Gly380Arg variant constitutively activates FGFR3 signaling, excessively inhibiting proliferation and differentiation of growth-plate chondrocytes while intramembranous ossification is relatively preserved.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Rhizomelic short limbs, macrocephaly, frontal bossing, and heterozygous FGFR3 p.Gly380Arg identify achondroplasia, in which constitutive FGFR3 signaling suppresses growth-plate chondrocyte proliferation/differentiation.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Intramembranous ossification is relatively preserved in achondroplasia; the disproportionate limb shortening arises from impaired endochondral growth at the epiphyseal plate.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The genotype and characteristic disproportionate phenotype make reduced growth-plate chondrocyte proliferation/differentiation uniquely correct.
